starting_point: original pretrained LFM2.5; newly initialized plugin and zero-effect LoRA; no tiny-batch or task-finetuned checkpoint loaded
objective: unchanged full-suffix CE; separately report answer and ending CE; stopping and selection use answer CE
selection: 4096 balanced questions by unchanged seed/ID hash from the same 240k official-train pool, including prior 256 diagnostic IDs; use all unchanged 1000 official-validation questions with natural class frequencies; select lowest full-validation answer CE among trained plugin states
scope: small-data training experiment: 4096 unique questions, 1.7067% of the fixed 240k pool or 0.3413% of the official 1.2M train split; repeated shuffled epochs; full 1000-question validation, not benchmark test
training_policy: plugin only up to 12 epochs or 3 hours, with validation-based early stopping; restore best trained plugin, then jointly train plugin and LoRA at 1e-5 for at most 1 epoch, 30 minutes and one quarter as many updates; original VLM frozen throughout
stop_policy: full validation once per plugin epoch; after at least 3 epochs, stop after 4 consecutive checks without meaningful answer-CE improvement > max(0.01,0.5%) against last meaningful best; joint checks every half epoch with patience 2; exact lowest answer CE selects checkpoints independently of the stopping threshold; budget or epoch caps are not convergence claims
training_curve_scope: fixed 512-question monitor from training set; training still uses all 4096 questions each epoch; report its metrics separately from full 1000-question validation

runtime_estimate.expected_active_hours: about 1-3, depending on early stopping and preprocessing; hard allocation cap 4
runtime_estimate.caveat: prior throughput came from cached tiny batches; larger bounded-cache run may be slower; queue wait excluded
